messages:
Samir Khan: Hey all, Samir here — started this morning in Sales! Quick onboarding questions: I don't have HubSpot/Gong/Outreach access yet, can't reach the demo sandbox, and want to sign up for a shadowing slot this week. Who do I bug for each and is there a short checklist I should follow? Thanks! :wave:

Nina Park: welcome Samir! :tada: Start with the onboarding checklist: https://docs.redwood.ai/internal/sales-onboarding-v1 (bookmark it). For seats ping @DevOps Bot with your employee ID. Shadowing slots are on the enablement calendar (link below).

Samir Khan: thanks — emp id 90214. Shadowing calendar?

DevOps Bot: Onboarding request submitted for employee 90214. HubSpot seat: pending. Gong group: pending. Outreach invite: pending. Estimated completion: 4 business hours. If you need urgent access for a demo today, tag @Leo.

Leo Ramos: @Samir if you have a live demo today DM me and I'll provision a temp sandbox link (expires 24h). For permanent demo access open the internal request form: https://idp.redwood.ai/demo-access. Also note the demo creds are rotated daily; do NOT reuse creds in recordings.

Samir Khan: got it. Can someone point me to our call script and the scoring rubric? I want to review before shadowing.

Evie Morgan: Call scripts + scoring rubric are in the playbook: https://docs.redwood.ai/sales/playbook (see 'Discovery call' & 'Demo' sections). Scoring rubric is under /ops/templates -> file name 'call-scoring-v3.pdf'. Objection-handling snippets are a quick paste in the playbook appendix under 'Objections'.

Tanya Singh: I'm running enablement sessions Wed/Thu 10–11am PT this week. Drop into the calendar 'Sales Enablement - New Hires' and pick a slot. If you're in EMEA I can do a 1:1 async review.

Samir Khan: I'm PST so I'll take Wed. One more: Outreach sequences — do I get the AE sequences or SDR ones?

Nina Park: AEs get the 'Outbound - AEs' bucket. Outreach admin will add you once your seat is active. If you need to see templates now, I can export them to a gist.

Leo Ramos: For Gong recordings make sure your Slack/Gong email matches your HubSpot user email, otherwise recordings won't map to contacts. If you're missing mapping DM me the email you want used. Also add your email to the Gong group 'sales-reps' once invite arrives.

Samir Khan: email is samir.k@redwood.ai. Also curious: who owns updating one-pagers and competitive battle cards? Found a small factual mismatch on our pricing blurb.

Evie Morgan: Competitive battlcards owned by Product Marketing (cc @Nina). One-pagers live in Marketing drive but content edits for sales collateral go through #sales-deck-review. If it's a pricing mismatch, open a PR or ping me and I can make the change.

Nina Park: Quick onboarding checklist I send new reps:
- Submit IDP + emp id in form
- HubSpot seat granted
- Reach out to DevOps for Gong/Outreach if pending
- Join #sales, #sales-deck-review, #deals-ops
- Book shadowing slot with Tanya
- Review playbook sections: Discovery/Demo/Closing
- Ask for demo sandbox if doing live demos
I'll paste the checklist doc after this thread.

DevOps Bot: HubSpot seat for 90214: active. Outreach invite: sent. Gong invite: sent. Demo sandbox request: awaiting manual approval by Leo.

Samir Khan: I see HubSpot and Outreach invites — Gong incoming. Thanks everyone, booking the enablement slot now :rocket:

Leo Ramos: Gong invite sent to samir.k@redwood.ai. If you want a paired shadowing session for your first demo, ping me and I'll join.

Samir Khan: awesome, appreciate it! :heart:
